exclusions: Death due to an activity under Special Exclusion or Special Terms and Conditions shown on the Certificate of Life Assurance (premiums refunded instead of the Death benefit)
Death by suicide within 12 months from the cover start date or date of reinstatement (policy voided, premiums refunded)
Covered illness (Critical Illness or Early Protect) existing before the cover start date or date of reinstatement
Any benefit for a covered illness due directly or indirectly to a pre-existing condition, unless declared in the proposal and specifically accepted
Heart attack of specified severity, major cancer (including carcinoma in situ), or other serious coronary artery disease diagnosed within 90 days of the cover start date or reinstatement
Coronary artery disease diagnosed within 90 days of the cover start date leading to bypass surgery, or needing angioplasty/other invasive coronary treatment
Diabetic complications diagnosed within 90 days of the cover start date or reinstatement
Covered illness caused by self-inflicted injuries while sane or insane
AIDS, AIDS-related complex, or infection by HIV (except specifically defined exceptions for blood transfusion or occupationally acquired HIV)
Using unprescribed drugs where the drugs are required by law to be prescribed by a Registered Medical Practitioner
An activity under Special Exclusion and/or Special Terms and Conditions shown on the Certificate of Life Assurance (critical illness claims)
Taking part in or attempting to take part in an unlawful act
coverage_gaps: Life/death coverage is only $20,000 - structurally fixed at 20% of the Critical Illness sum assured, not an independent death benefit; this is a CI-led plan with a small bolt-on death benefit, not a life plan with a CI rider

Critical Illness and Early Protect (pre-critical/early-stage) benefits share the same $100,000 pool - claiming one reduces what remains for the other, so the real maximum CI-related payout ceiling is $100,000 not $200,000
No disability or income protection benefit attached to this policy at all (no Accelerated Disability, no TPD rider) - unlike the PRUActive Term policy held by the same person
No hospitalisation or Integrated Shield Plan coverage
No accidental death and dismemberment coverage

A naive extractor pattern-matching on the policy name or grabbing the largest/first sum assured figure will almost certainly output $100,000 for sum_assured_sgd; correct ground truth per the life/death-only schema definition is $20,000. This is a more direct version of the PRUActive Term fabrication trap (formula-derived sum, not an independently underwritten figure) but harder to catch since the benefit row name matches the product name exactly.
